newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait crown prince recovering after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait crown prince recovering after surgery.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah is in stable condition after colon surgery early on Saturday, a minister said.
"The Crown Prince's condition is stable and satisfactory," the minister of court affairs, Sheikh Nasser Mohammad al-Ahmad al-Sabah, said in a statement carried by the official Kuwait News Agency.
He said the operation was performed at 5.30 a.m. (0230 GMT).
Sheikh Saad, born 1930, was rushed to Emiri Hospital in Kuwait City on Tuesday after fainting due to internal bleeding. He was released on Thursday, but returned to hospital a day later.
Diplomatic sources said Saudi Arabia's King Fahd had offered his medical aircraft to carry the crown prince if he sought treatment abroad.
"I am, thank God, in good health," Sheikh Saad said on Thursday as he left hospital.
Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah visited the crown prince on Friday at hospital while several regional leaders telephoned to inquire about his health.
